newsitem.title: USA: Ogden sees Q3, Q4 entertainment unit growth.
newsitem.headline: Ogden sees Q3, Q4 entertainment unit growth.

text.p: Ogden Corp said Monday its entertainment group will have strong double digit growth in the third and fourth quarters as compared with the corresponding periods a year ago.

The company said the entertainment business remains heavily seasonal, but the performance of the group during the second quarter provides it with "concrete evidence" that it will see the double digit growth.
The entertainment group's second quarter income was $6.7 million compared to $5.1 million Revenues in the unit were $105.1 million compared to $98.4 million.

The company said the "strong" comparisons for the second quarter were primarily driven by increased attendance at amphitheaters and improved performance in Europe. But these results, it said, were partially offset by continued development expenses related to the American Wilderness Experience.

The company said it invests an "increasing amount of resources" launching new branded concepts such as the American Wilderness Experience. It said, however, that the entertainment group's portfolio continues to show margin improvement.

The company reported second quarter earnings per share of $0.40 compared to $0.34 for the same period a year ago. Total revenues were $451.9 million compared to $546.1 million for the same period a year ago.
The company said its other core businesses showed positive comparisions as well.
